column1: # House facilities by object id, and the nexus menu's destination names, read by PohKnowledge.
# Object ids are RuneLite gameval ObjectID names with their ids; tests check every name=id pair.
#   object       facility key  objects...         "a+b" keys name two facilities in one object
#   portal       destination  objects...          a portal room portal (poh.portal.<destination>)
#   portal_pair  destination  other destination  objects...   a two-destination portal (poh.portal_alt.<other>)
#   nexus        destination  menu names...       names the nexus menu uses for the destination
# Portal chamber portals, by destination (gameval ObjectID / ObjectID1, RuneLite 1.13.1: teak, mahogany, marble). The
# Varrock, Camelot and Watchtower portals have a second form per left-click destination (GE, Seers', Yanille).
# The plain forms (no diary) go to one place. After the diary each has two forms, named by the left-click destination
# ("..._VARROCK1ST", "..._GE1ST"); the other place is the right-click option (OSRS Wiki "Portal chamber": medium Varrock,
# hard Kandarin, hard Ardougne diaries). Recorded as poh.portal.<left> and poh.portal_alt.<right>.
# Not recorded: Wilderness destinations (Annakarl, Carrallangar, Ghorrock, Forgotten Cemetery): never routed.
# Portal nexus destinations by the name the nexus menus show (OSRS Wiki "Portal nexus" / "Portal chamber" destination names).
